reference.question: Let \(e_1=(1,0)\) and \(e_2=(0,1)\). Express the vector \((3,5)\) as a linear combination of \(e_1\) and \(e_2\). What is the coefficient of \(e_2\)?
reference.solution:
Method 1: Standard-basis decomposition

Since \((3,5)=3e_1+5e_2\), the coefficient of \(e_2\) is \(5\).
